title: Thai Tofu Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired curry made with crispy tofu and a blend of aromatic spices. Serve over steamed rice or noodles for a delicious and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Extra-firm tofu
ingredients.amount: 1 block, drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
Add the curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the lime juice, fish sauce, and stir to combine.
Return the tofu to the skillet and stir to coat with the curry sauce.
Add the bell pepper and onion to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the basil leaves and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot over steamed rice or noodles.
